item.title: Corfu fire department honors legacy of Jim Mallory at installation dinner
item.description: 2024 file photo by Howard Owens. Pictured, Greg Lang, Jim Mallory, and Dean Eck The Corfu Volunteer Fire Department dedicated its truck room to the late Jim Mallory at its annual installation and awards dinner Saturday at the Corfu Village Hall.Mallory, who died Oct. 27 at age 90, served the department for 72 years. He joined in September 1953 and remained active until his death, responding to calls, attending training sessions and serving as a fire district commissioner.Chaplain Brad Lang walke
